name: D1 双 for 列表推导
code: print([x * y for x in range(3) for y in range(2)])

name: D2 双 for + 条件
code: print([x * y for x in range(3) if x > 0 for y in range(2) if y > 0])

name: D3 双 for 集合推导
code: print(sorted({x + y for x in range(2) for y in range(2)}))

name: D4 双 for 字典推导
code: print({x: y for x in range(2) for y in range(2)})

name: D5 单 for 对照
code: print([x * 2 for x in range(4)])

name: D6 单 for + 条件对照
code: print([x for x in range(5) if x % 2 == 0])

name: D7 三 for
code: print([x * y * z for x in range(1, 3) for y in range(1, 3) for z in range(1, 3)])

name: D8 双 for 用前面变量
code: print([y for x in range(3) for y in range(x)])

name: D9 双 for 嵌套在表达式里
code: print(sum([x * y for x in range(3) for y in range(3)]))

name: D11 双 for 推导里的函数调用
D12 双 for 后接属性/下标
code:
xs = [[1, 2], [3]]
print([n for row in xs for n in row])

name: D13 嵌套推导（内层双 for）
code: print([[x * y for x in range(2) for y in range(2)] for k in range(2)])

name: D14 双 for 条件用两个变量
code: print([x * 10 + y for x in range(4) for y in range(4) if x + y == 3])

name: D15 旧值恢复（P60 作用域）
code:
x = 99
b = [x for x in range(3)]
print(b)
print(x)

name: D16 双 for 覆盖字典键
code: print({x: y for x in range(2) for y in range(3)})

name: D17 三 for 带条件
code: print([x * y * z for x in range(2) for y in range(2) for z in range(2) if x + y > 0])

name: D18 双 for 迭代字符串
code: print([a + b for a in 'ab' for b in '12'])

name: D19 双 for 迭代集合
code: print(sorted([a * b for a in {1, 2} for b in {1, 2}]))

name: D20 双 for 迭代元组
code: print([a + b for a in (1, 2) for b in (10, 20)])

name: D21 双 for 内层调函数
D22 双 for 后接 if 用外层变量
code: print([y for x in range(3) for y in range(3) if y > x])

name: D23 集合推导双 for 条件
code: print(sorted({x * y for x in range(3) for y in range(3) if x != y}))

name: D24 双 for 推导嵌在函数里
D25 双 for 外层是列表字面量
code: print([a * b for a in [2, 3] for b in [10, 100]])

name: D26 字典推导单 for 不退化
code: print({k: k * 2 for k in range(3)})

name: D27 推导结果参与运算
code: print(sum([x * y for x in range(3) for y in range(3)]))

name: D28 双 for 里的条件用 in
code: print([x for x in range(4) for y in range(4) if x in (1, 2) and y == x])

name: D29 连续两个推导
code:
a = [x for x in range(2)]
b = [x * y for x in a for y in a]
print(b)

name: D30 双 for 推导 length
code: print(len([x + y for x in range(2) for y in range(3)]))

name: D31 单 for 条件后接第二 for
code: print([x + y for x in range(3) if x > 0 for y in range(3) if y < 2])

name: D32 双 for 变量与外层同名
code:
x = 5
print([x for x in range(2) for y in range(2)])
print(x)
